final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT r.circuitId, c.country, AVG(r.round) AS avg_round FROM races AS r JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY r.circuitId, c.country), s2 AS (SELECT c.country, AVG(r.round) AS avg_round FROM races AS r JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY c.country) SELECT s1.circuitId, s1.country, s1.avg_round, s1.avg_round - s2.avg_round FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s1.country = s2.country COLLATE BINARY ORDER BY s1.avg_round - s2.avg_round DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
